events.title: Tupac Shakur's Passing
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, influential rapper Tupac Shakur was tragically shot in Las Vegas, passing away six days later.

angles.name: Remembering Tupac
angles.copy: Remembering the legend Tupac Shakur, who would have been 55 this year. His impact on music and culture remains undeniable.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing
events.blurb: This day marks the anniversary of the death of legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix in 1970.

angles.name: Tribute to Jimi Hendrix
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 84 this year. His guitar wizardry changed music forever.

events.title: Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album in 1969, featuring timeless tracks like 'Come Together' and 'Here Comes the Sun'.

angles.name: Abbey Road Legacy
angles.copy: 57 years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. Which track is still on heavy rotation for you?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the formidable lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie Hynde
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman and rock 'n' roll star Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam Gallagher
angles.copy: Our kid Liam Gallagher is 54 today! What's your favourite Oasis or solo track from the man himself? As you were.

events.title: Imagine Album Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his seminal solo album 'Imagine' in 1971, featuring the timeless title track.

angles.name: Imagine Album Legacy
angles.copy: 55 years since John Lennon's 'Imagine' album asked us to dream a little bigger. Its message still resonates today.

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the very first iPod in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music on the go.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the first time you got an iPod? 25 years since Apple changed the game for portable music. What was on your first playlist?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: It's James Bond Day, celebrating the iconic film franchise that began with 'Dr. No' in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond Theme
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Which iconic theme tune gets you shaken, not stirred?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're remembering the extraordinary life and music of John Lennon.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese, best known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the comedic genius, John Cleese! What's your favourite Python sketch or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, famously known as the 'White Album', in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Legacy
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles' iconic 'White Album' dropped. A masterpiece of diverse sounds. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: This day marks the anniversary of the passing of Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury, in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 this year. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential album 'Rubber Soul' in 1965, marking a significant shift in their sound.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Legacy
angles.copy: 61 years since The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' changed the game. A landmark album that pushed boundaries.

events.title: John Lennon's Passing
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon on the anniversary of his tragic death in 1980.

angles.name: John Lennon Remembrance
angles.copy: On this day, we remember John Lennon, who would have been 86. His music and message continue to inspire generations.
